product_name: California Gold Nutrition, Sport, Pure Creatine Monohydrate, Unflavored, 1 lb (454 g)
why_used: Creatine Monohydrate is a popular dietary supplement primarily used by athletes and fitness enthusiasts to enhance athletic performance, increase muscle strength, power output, and support muscle growth and recovery during high-intensity, short-duration activities.
benefits: Increases muscle strength and power during short bursts of exercise.
Enhances high-intensity exercise performance, allowing for more reps or heavier lifts.
Supports muscle growth by increasing cell volumization and promoting protein synthesis.
worth_buying: NO - While California Gold Nutrition is a reputable iHerb house brand, the total landed cost (product + shipping + import duties) makes it significantly more expensive than comparable quality creatine monohydrate available from local authorized distributors or well-established Indian supplement brands. For most consumers prioritizing value, local alternatives offer better cost efficiency without the import complexities.
common_complaints: Gastrointestinal discomfort (bloating, stomach cramps) when not adequately hydrated or taken on an empty stomach.
Water retention and temporary weight gain (often intramuscular, which is beneficial but can be perceived negatively).
Concerns about kidney or liver strain (largely debunked for healthy individuals at recommended doses, but a common user worry).
transit_risks: FSSAI (Food Safety and Standards Authority of India) clearance: Supplements are subject to FSSAI regulations; incorrect labeling or documentation can lead to delays or rejection.
Customs valuation disputes: Indian customs may re-evaluate the product's value, potentially leading to higher duties.
Quantity restrictions for personal use: Large quantities of supplements might be flagged for commercial intent, requiring additional licenses.
Tracking accuracy and delays: International tracking can sometimes be unreliable or updated with significant delays, especially during the customs clearance phase.
Damage or loss in transit: Though less common, longer international transit times increase the risk of package mishandling.
eta: Typically 10-20 business days for standard international shipping from iHerb to India, subject to customs clearance times.
cheaper_alternative: Local Indian brands like MuscleBlaze, Myprotein India (from local stock), or Nakpro offer creatine monohydrate at a significantly lower price point, often ranging from INR 1000-2000 for 500g, without the added shipping and import charges. Established international brands like Optimum Nutrition or Universal Nutrition, when purchased from authorized Indian distributors, can also be more cost-effective than importing this specific product after all costs are considered. Bulk purchasing multiple items from iHerb could potentially optimize shipping and duty costs per item, but for a single item, local options generally provide better value.
